title: Walmart just scored a huge victory over Amazon with Apple’s help (AMZN, AAPL, WMT)
text: Walmart just scored a huge victory over Amazon with Apple’s help (AMZN, AAPL, WMT) Posted By: BusinessInsider May 9, 2018 Jet.com is now a reseller of Apple products, including the iPhone, it announced on Wednesday. Jet.com is a subsidiary of Walmart and runs independently. Walmart is already a massive Apple retailer. Amazon carries some Apple products, including Mac computers — but not the iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. It’s possible to buy those products on Amazon, but they are sold by third-party companies. Amazon said in 2015 that it would stop selling Apple products that compete with its own streaming media players…although the Apple TV returned to Amazon this past December . Jet will also offer discounts on certain Apple bundles, it said. To check them out, click here .
